title: Instacart Cosmic Sorcerer
description: A man dressed in an elaborate black, purple, and orange sorcerer's coat with skull patterns stands dramatically in the center of a cosmic scene. He is surrounded by floating Instacart delivery bags, grocery advertisements, and a surreal space background featuring planets, nebulae, a giant blue eye, and green delivery drones.
prompt: A dramatic male figure wearing a flamboyant purple and black sorcerer coat with orange skull patterns and silver buttons stands in a powerful pose at the center of a surreal cosmic landscape. Floating Instacart grocery delivery bags, orange and green coolers, and digital advertisement screens surround him. The background features swirling galaxies, a giant blue eye planet, green delivery drones, and ethereal space creatures, in a highly detailed surreal digital art style.
